items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 17:1
items.html: See the Table of Answers above, Part 7, Answer 31. Indeed, Hesed alone also comprises five Hassadim, and Gevura five Gevurot; and the reason is that every Sefira is comprised of ten Sefirot. (p. 644, Item 47)
